motion_rule: she lies on the ice, the market flies at her: each spoken beat exactly one thing smears across the lens a shoulder away; nothing far, nothing vertical; camera tracks sideways at ice level; never wider than the seller waist-up, macro on her muzzle; new shot size each beat
character: a plump mackerel, mirror-striped flank, on crushed ice, gills and jaw working, same fish throughout
second_characters: ONE heavy seller, white cap, apron, gold teeth, hands and belly sweeping the lens; ONE buyer, arms and trolley only
props: ONE card reading 3999 on a spike; A SWARM of half-rotten salmon heads; ONE paper card reading soup pot on a crate; ONE bag; ONE fish bone
prop_continuity: the heads lie under the soup pot card from 0.65; that crate is over his shoulder at 7.55-8.85
environment: a crowded fish market row, roof daylight, counters and crates a fin away both sides
light_events: flat white noon, a mirror flash down her flank at 3.65-4.25, a gold glint off his teeth at 8.20

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: smug female mackerel voice, biting each word off, 4 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: prosh-LI, vre-me-NA, lo-SO-sya, te-PER, ma-YA, O-che-red, blis-TAT, BU-desh, KAZH-doy, KOS-toch-ke
audio.pacing: 0.00-1.95, 2.00-4.25 and 4.25-6.30 each one breath; after 6.30 not a word, sfx only
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable
audio.sfx: ice crunching, fish slapping, scales creaking, his guffaw, market din

timeline.a: her tail whips A SWARM of salmon heads off the ice across the lens into the next crate, jaw working, a soup pot card landing on them
her eye follows the heads and back to the lens; a scoop of ice rides past a hand away
her mouth opens, gills clap once; his hand rams the 3999 spike into the ice a fin away, chips flying at the lens
one pectoral fin lifts at the card; the buyer hauls a trolley of crates across frame right behind her
her head turns to the lens, the fin drops; his white cap cuts across the lens shoving a wet rag, spray flying
her chin lifts, the flank catches light, body never rolls; he dumps a bucket, ice avalanches past at the lens, glare on her scales
her eye widens, jaw working on every syllable; the buyer's hand rips a fish from the next heap, it slumps at the lens
her jaw works on every syllable; his belly passes a hand from the lens, the scale hook swinging after
her jaw keeps working, one slow blink; an empty bag balloons open at the lens in his fist
the bag pops in his fist and his hand rakes her off the ice into it, tail sticking out
the bag slams on the scales at the lens, needle punching over, ice bouncing
bag to the buyer, banknotes into his paw and under his coat at the glass; his free hand rips a white bone out of the soup pot crate
his face fills the lens, he guffaws and picks his teeth with that bone, grinning crooked and mean, her head in the bag low in frame, eye on the lens
he keeps picking, the bag swings in the buyer's hand, the soup pot crate at his shoulder

must_appear: the 3999 card stands in the ice beside her from 1.30; every line spoken, last word by 6.30; the punch is the seller's: his bone, his teeth, his grin, face to the lens, no backs after 8.15; she blinks in the bag
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, a wide shot, a parked camera, slow motion, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, floating objects, blood, duplicate props, cuts
